title: Capability table replay floor dies on LRU eviction: evicted announcer can roll back cached_seq
description: Found by worker-1's audit of the landed 7nnl.3 dispatch (kimi-k3 verification pass). rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:1738-1743 gates announcement replay via capability_table.cached_seq(&iid); rust/lichen-gateway/src/capability.rs:85-89 returns None for an LRU-evicted announcer, and verify_announcement (capability_announcements.rs:317-321) skips the seq gate entirely when cached_seq is None (if let Some(cached)). Attack: flood the 192-entry regular partition to evict a gateway's entry, then replay its older still-unexpired announcement - the table is rolled back and the stale capability is re-cached (routing/egress trust decisions consumed from the table would follow stale state). Fix options: (a) persist the per-IID high-water seq outside the LRU (separate bounded map keyed by IID, like the slot-claim replay cache pattern), or (b) make eviction preserve/compact seq floors, or (c) fail-closed when the announcer was previously tracked (mirrors GCP-6.5 STATE_FULL semantics). Note the sibling precedent: l1qw.21 tracks the same class of problem for the GCP-6.5 claim_seq cache (spec requires <=64 LRU; no LRU anywhere). Coordinate the two if a shared eviction-with-floor pattern lands.
